children.name: entity
children.description: The name of the entity to retrieve. For example, `product`.

children.name: fields
children.description: The fields and relations to retrieve in the entity.

children.name: pagination
children.description: Pagination configurations for the returned list of items.

children.name: skip
children.description: The number of items to skip before retrieving the returned items.

children.name: take
children.description: The maximum number of items to return.

children.name: order
children.description: Sort by field names in ascending or descending order.

children.name: filters
children.description: Filters to apply on the retrieved items.

children.name: context
children.description: Apply a query context on the retrieved data. For example, to retrieve product prices for a certain context.

children.name: withDeleted
children.description: Apply a `withDeleted` flag on the retrieved data to retrieve soft deleted items.
